objective: Minimum allocation-free original-root lifetime repair for accessible payloads only; retain IR01 permanent scope barrier.
fixed_contract: Output obligation originates in the actual original caller-retained BootstrapLedgerV1 borrowed by the admitted acquisition; short owner views and child TrustedHostAccount are not substitutes.

Every accessible owning payload across matched, refused, loader error, extraction, adoption, leaf, diagnostics and resources retains that root obligation transitively. An opaque outer wrapper alone is insufficient if an extractor strips it.
No new root/quote/funding partition/counter/shared allocation/refcount/registry/synchronization replaces the original root borrow. Test observers are instrumentation only, not authority.

Issue correlation scope -> permanent IR01 barrier before publishing scope; no Complete/refund even after all results are destroyed, extracted, forgotten, unused or refused. No renewal of acquisition or cleanup work.
Normal scalar observations may copy while originals remain borrowed/owned within the original root lifetime; they do not qualify ownership of actual errors/proofs/resources.
A direct original-root lifetime may allow the acquisition owner to end before an accessible result; the original root must still survive it. No arbitrary output lifetime or static upgrade.

Allocation-free is not layout/price-free: independently enumerate all added pointer/marker/capture/temporary/return places and complete changed MIR bodies. No price/layout approval follows from lifetime success.
